entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An Argivian brother who becomes Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms, activates the Golgothian Sylex at Argoth and ascends.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, enslaved by Fallaji nomads, who becomes Qadir of the Fallaji Empire and is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The archaeologist to whom Urza and Mishra are apprenticed; she dies in an explosion between the brothers.

entities.name: Rusko
entities.description: A clockmaker in Kroog to whom Urza becomes apprenticed.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The princess of Yotia whom Urza marries.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A character who discovers Mishra and helps him become tutor to the Suwwardi Qadir's son.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice, captured and later freed by Ashnod, who delivers the Sylex to Urza.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's apprentice who leads forces for him, helps Tawnos escape and is banished.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon summoned to Koilos who lures the brothers to Argoth and drives artifact creatures mad.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Kayla's son, an ornithopter pilot who discovers Argoth.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Harbin's son, who later travels to the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: A character who flees Terisia City with the Golgothian Sylex and is captured by Ashnod.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A character who dies defending Terisia City.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A time-traveler who makes repeated jumps back in time to the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian sleeper agent created from Mishra's flesh.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: A defender of Argoth killed in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An ancient device that Urza activates at Argoth.

entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: Artifacts created when the brothers split a Thran powerstone.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Caves of Thran origin enclosing a portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city destroyed by dragon engines.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island where the last battle of the Brothers' War is fought and which the Sylex Blast obliterates.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A cult that summons Gix and infiltrates and betrays the Third Path.

entities.name: Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: The union of Argive and Korlis, led by Urza as Lord Protector.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: A group established in Terisia City and infiltrated by the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: The nascent church that crusades against artifice and magic after the war.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast that obliterates Argoth and sends Dominaria into an Ice Age.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Brothers' War takes place.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra are born on the first and last day of the Argivian year.
events.quote: Urza and Mishra are born on the first and last day of the year, respectively.

events.summary: The brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos, and the brothers split a powerstone, creating the Mightstone and Weakstone.
events.quote: The brothers split a Thran powerstone , accidentally creating the Mightstone and Weakstone .

events.summary: A conflict between the brothers kills Tocasia in an explosion; Mishra flees and is enslaved by Fallaji nomads while Urza apprentices to Rusko.
events.quote: A conflict between the brothers arises, with Tocasia accidentally caught in between and killed in an explosion.

events.summary: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog, princess of Yotia.
events.quote: Urza marries Kayla bin-Kroog , the princess of Yotia .

events.summary: Mishra gains control of a Phyrexian dragon engine and becomes the new Qadir's head wizard.
events.quote: Mishra gains control over a Phyrexian dragon engine and becomes the new Qadir's head wizard.

events.summary: A peace summit at Korlinda ends in disaster and the Warlord of Kroog dies, leaving Urza in charge.
events.quote: The Warlord of Kroog dies, leaving Urza in charge.

events.summary: Peace talks at Kroog end disastrously and mark the official start of the Brothers' War; the phyrexian demon enters Dominaria as Gix.
events.quote: a new peace conference in Kroog also ends disastrously and marks the official beginning of the Brothers' War .

events.summary: Kroog is destroyed by dragon engines while Urza is stuck in the desert, and the Qadir of the Fallaji is killed.
events.quote: Kroog is destroyed by dragon engines while Urza is stuck in the desert.

events.summary: Mishra becomes the new Qadir of the Fallaji Empire.
events.quote: Mishra becomes the new Qadir of the Fallaji Empire.

events.summary: Argive and Korlis unite as the Combined Kingdoms, and Urza is appointed Lord Protector.
events.quote: Urza is appointed Lord Protector of the Realm.

events.summary: Urza leads the Combined Kingdoms to liberate Yotia from Fallaji rule.
events.quote: Urza gathers a large army and crosses the Khers for the first time since the fall of Kroog.

events.summary: After ten years of siege, Sarinth falls to Ashnod's forces and is forced into the Fallaji army.
events.quote: after ten years of siege, Sarinth is overtaken by Ashnod's forces and forced into the Fallaji army.

events.summary: The Tomakul Campaign reaches within ten miles of Tomakul before Sarinth reinforcements overwhelm the Combined Kingdoms.
events.quote: reinforcements from Sarinth overwhelm the Combined Kimgdoms within sight of the city, and they are pushed back.

events.summary: Ashnod helps the captured Tawnos escape; the Brotherhood of Gix persuades Mishra to banish her.
events.quote: The Brotherhood of Gix discovers this and persuades Mishra to banish her.

events.summary: The Gixians betray the Third Path; Hurkyl dies defending Terisia City and Loran flees with the Sylex.
events.quote: Hurkyl dies defending the city.

events.summary: Ashnod captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains and takes the Sylex.
events.quote: Loran is captured by Ashnod near the Colekgan Mountains.

events.summary: Harbin discovers Argoth and the Combined Kingdoms invade it; Gix lures Urza and Mishra there.
events.quote: Gix also lures Urza and Mishra to Argoth in order to make them face each other physically.

events.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
events.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

events.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urza activates the Sylex.

events.summary: In the aftermath, Argive, Yotia, Yumok, Malpiri and Korlis collapse and the Dark Age begins.
events.quote: Almaaz is the only state on Terisiare to remain intact. The Dark Age begins.

events.summary: The First Talite Crusade purges the Gixian lands and destroys the Monastery of Gix.
events.quote: the nascent Church of Tal begins a crusade against artifice and magic

events.summary: Xantcha is created from Mishra's flesh as a sleeper agent for Phyrexia's invasion.
events.quote: Xantcha is created from Mishra 's flesh

events.summary: The Second Talite Crusade destroys the machines at Urza's Tower and Mishra's Fortress.
events.quote: They battle and destroy all of Mishra's machines there, at the cost of several lives

events.summary: A cadre of planeswalkers including Teferi, Saheeli Rai and Kaya Cassir use time travel to return to the Brothers' War and learn the use of the Sylex.
events.quote: use time travel to return to the time of the Brothers' War and learn the use of the Sylex.

relations.quote: The brothers strip the island of its resources during their battles.
